# Utku Ege Tuluk Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Utku Ege Tuluk, a Research Engineer & AI and Emerging Technology Manager based in Shanghai, China. Features AI-powered personalized layouts generated for different visitor types.

## About

Utku Ege Tuluk is a Research Engineer and AI & Emerging Technology Manager at NYU Shanghai with 3+ years building production AI for education. Leads the Ask, Create, Train framework: multi-tenant AI assistants, an internal platform for AI-powered apps, and on-premises serving of quantized open-weight LLMs. Built Kiwi, a multimodal learning platform serving 300+ students and processing 100M+ tokens. Expertise in full-stack development, LLM infrastructure, and AI agents.

## Contact

## Projects

- KIWI - Multimodal AI Learning Platform: Enterprise-scale multimodal learning platform serving 300+ students across 6 classes, featuring real-time AI-powered chat, intelligent PDF annotation, and in-browser Python execution.
- ASK - Multi-Tenant AI Assistant Platform: Multi-tenant AI assistant platform behind NYU Shanghai's Ask Angie (faculty support), Ask Roary (library), and Ask RITS, cutting faculty response times from hours to instant.
- Create - AI Sites Platform: Internal multi-tenant platform where NYU Shanghai users deploy small web apps, or generate them from a prompt, each with its own database, storage, serverless functions, and campus-hosted LLM access.
- On-Premises LLM Inference Stack: Production LLM serving for NYU Shanghai: quantized open-weight models on on-premises and HPC GPUs, exposed through a LiteLLM gateway to campus apps and users.
- AI Companion - App, Voice & Hardware: Full-stack AI companion product: a mobile app with personality-driven characters, voice-cloned speech, and a Bluetooth companion device with on-device wake-word recognition.
- AI Song Generation Service: Self-hosted text-to-song service at NYU Shanghai: lyrics and a style prompt become a full song with vocals, generated on a single 12 GB GPU.
- Fly Brain Robot: A complete fruit-fly connectome, simulated as 165k spiking neurons, sees through a robot arm's cameras and drives its joints through the fly's own front-leg motor neurons.
- MiniMax-H3 on Apple Silicon: Runs MiniMax-H3 text-to-video-with-audio locally on a MacBook by rebuilding its MLX 4-bit pack byte-for-byte from the official BF16 weights.
- Spiegel - AI VTuber Platform: AI VTuber streaming platform: a desktop chat aggregator for YouTube, Twitch, and Kick plus an AI-driven avatar with real-time lip-sync and speech.

## Skills

Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, React, React Native, NestJS, FastAPI, Electron, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Terraform, Cloudflare Workers, vLLM, LiteLLM, MCP, LLM Agents, RAG, Vector Databases
